text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Private sector urged to raise salaries to keep with the general pay rise for government employees. Bahrain said it had allocated 45 million dinars for 1997 and 1998 to increase salaries of government employees.
- About 132 new businesses were established in Bahrain in 1996 with an overall capital of 36 million dinars.
- Bahrain's 1996 foreign trade declined by 158 million dinars.
- Labour minister signs a one million dinar agreement to set up a Saudi training centre in Bahrain.
